WhisTrainingConfig.FinishedText: There is nothing left to teach you, Angel. Do drop by if you bring dessert.
WhisTrainingConfig.StationHint: Talk to Whis in the Cell Games Arena.

Tiers.ActiveText: Hohoho, still warming up? Come back when you're done.
Tiers.Name: Training I
Tiers.OfferText: Oh my, you want to train with me? Let's start light. Defeat the fighters of the Cell Games Arena and I'll lend you some training gear.
Tiers.ReadyText: Not bad at all. Here, your Weighted Training Gear.

Tiers.ActiveText: My staff is still out there in Namek City. Do keep looking.
Tiers.Name: Training II
Tiers.OfferText: I seem to have misplaced my staff on Namek. Would you be a dear and find it for me?
Tiers.ReadyText: My staff! Wonderful. A little tap of thanks for you.

Tiers.ActiveText: Those waves won't clear themselves. Keep going.
Tiers.Name: Training III
Tiers.OfferText: Endurance next. Clear raid waves until your legs give out, then clear some more.
Tiers.ReadyText: You barely broke a sweat. Time for the Gravity Chamber.

Tiers.ActiveText: Keep investing in yourself. I'll be right here.
Tiers.Name: Training IV
Tiers.OfferText: A strong fighter invests in themselves. Spend your Yen growing stronger, and I'll show you Divine Ki.
Tiers.ReadyText: Can you feel it? That's Divine Ki.

Tiers.ActiveText: Broly is still standing, I'm afraid.
Tiers.Name: Training V
Tiers.OfferText: Now for a real opponent. Defeat Broly at full power, again and again, until it feels easy.
Tiers.ReadyText: Blue suits you. Super Saiyan Blue, unlocked.

Tiers.ActiveText: My robes are still in Morioh Town. An angel can't walk around like this, you know.
Tiers.Name: Training VI
Tiers.OfferText: I left my robes somewhere in Morioh Town. Bring them back and I'll trust you with a staff of your own.
Tiers.ReadyText: Much better. Take this Angel Staff, you've earned it.

Tiers.ActiveText: More raids, please. Light on your feet.
Tiers.Name: Training VII
Tiers.OfferText: Footwork wins fights. Clear raids from start to finish, and move like an angel.
Tiers.ReadyText: Graceful! That's Angelic Footwork.

Tiers.ActiveText: Keep fighting, in any world you like.
Tiers.Name: Training VIII
Tiers.OfferText: Almost there. Fight everywhere, in every world, and a halo might just appear above you.
Tiers.ReadyText: Look at that halo. You're nearly one of us.

Tiers.ActiveText: The Grand Priest is watching. Finish both tasks.
Tiers.Name: Training IX
Tiers.OfferText: Your final trial. Defeat the arena's fighters once more and find my halo, I dropped it in the Gamemode Lobby.
Tiers.ReadyText: Congratulations. You are an Angel now, and the power of Hakai is yours.

ZenoMissionsConfig.FinishedText: Best friend! Let's play again later, okay?
ZenoMissionsConfig.StationHint: Talk to Zeno in the Cell Games Arena.

Tiers.ActiveText: More jumping! I'm still watching!
Tiers.Name: Jump Jump
Tiers.OfferText: Hi hi! You wanna play with me? I wanna see you jump! Jump jump jump!
Tiers.ReadyText: Wow, so bouncy! That was fun!

Tiers.ActiveText: Did you go on an adventure yet? Go go go!
Tiers.Name: Adventure Time
Tiers.OfferText: I'm bored. Go on an adventure! Join some gamemodes and tell me all about it!
Tiers.ReadyText: Adventures are the best! Thank you!

Tiers.ActiveText: Keep running! I'm gonna catch you!
Tiers.Name: Tag
Tiers.OfferText: Let's play tag! You run and run and run, and I'll pretend to chase you!
Tiers.ReadyText: You're so fast! You win!

Tiers.ActiveText: There are still worlds you haven't visited!
Tiers.Name: Multiverse Tour
Tiers.OfferText: I want to see ALL the worlds! Visit every single one of them for me!
Tiers.ReadyText: So many worlds! I like all of them! Maybe.

Tiers.ActiveText: More eggs! More critters!
Tiers.Name: Critter Collector
Tiers.OfferText: I want little critters! Open lots of eggs so we can have lots of friends!
Tiers.ReadyText: So many critters! They're so cute!

Tiers.ActiveText: Spin it again! Again!
Tiers.Name: New Toy
Tiers.OfferText: I want a new toy! Spin the gachas and show me what comes out!
Tiers.ReadyText: Ooh, shiny! I like this toy!

Tiers.ActiveText: There are still enemies! Erase! Erase!
Tiers.Name: Erase! Erase!
Tiers.OfferText: Erase them! Erase all of them! Defeat enemies anywhere you want!
Tiers.ReadyText: All erased! You're just like me!

Tiers.ActiveText: Where are your friends? Go find one!
Tiers.Name: Little Friend
Tiers.OfferText: Do you have friends? Join a party or play with a friend in the server! Friends are fun!
Tiers.ReadyText: Yay, friends! Now we're all friends!

Tiers.ActiveText: You're still here! Stay a little longer!
Tiers.Name: Stay With Me
Tiers.OfferText: Don't leave! Stay and play with me for a long, long time!
Tiers.ReadyText: You stayed! You're the best!

Tiers.ActiveText: There are still big ones! Erase them!
Tiers.Name: Erase the Big One
Tiers.OfferText: Last one! Erase the really really big ones! Defeat World Bosses! Then we're best friends!
Tiers.ReadyText: You did it! You're my best friend now! You can call me whenever you want!
